description: Production alert policies for VitaLuxePro security and performance monitoring

alert_rules.name: RLS Policy Violation Detected
alert_rules.description: Triggered when a user attempts to access data outside their Row Level Security permissions

actions.details: Log to security_events table with full context
Automatically rate-limit offending IP for 30 minutes
Send immediate notification to security team

alert_rules.supabase_query: SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE action_type = 'rls_violation' AND created_at > now() - interval '1 minute'

alert_rules.name: Edge Function Error Rate Exceeded
alert_rules.description: Triggered when edge function error rate exceeds 2% over 5-minute window

actions.details: Log error spike to admin_alerts table
Display banner in admin dashboard

alert_rules.supabase_query: SELECT function_name, COUNT(*) as errors FROM audit_logs WHERE action_type = 'edge_function_error' AND created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY function_name HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT COUNT(*) * 0.02 FROM audit_logs WHERE action_type = 'edge_function_call' AND created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes')

alert_rules.name: Large File Upload Detected
alert_rules.description: Triggered when a file upload exceeds 100MB (potential abuse or misconfiguration)

actions.details: Log large upload with user_id, file_name, file_size
Flag for manual review if file_size > 500MB

alert_rules.supabase_query: SELECT * FROM storage.objects WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 hour' AND metadata->>'size'::bigint > 104857600

alert_rules.name: Video Session Recording Timeout
alert_rules.description: Triggered when a video session with active recording exceeds 60 minutes

actions.details: Log long-running session to admin_alerts
Automatically stop recording at 90 minutes

alert_rules.supabase_query: SELECT * FROM video_sessions WHERE recording_status = 'active' AND started_at < now() - interval '60 minutes'

alert_rules.name: Document Management Fallback Triggered
alert_rules.description: Triggered when S3 fails and system falls back to Supabase Storage

actions.details: Log S3 failure with error details
Trigger S3 connectivity health check

alert_rules.supabase_query: SELECT COUNT(*) as fallback_count FROM audit_logs WHERE action_type = 's3_fallback_triggered' AND created_at > now() - interval '10 minutes'

alert_rules.name: Cart Checkout Error Rate
alert_rules.description: Triggered when checkout errors exceed 5% of attempts in 15-minute window

actions.details: Log checkout error patterns
Update checkout health dashboard

alert_rules.supabase_query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE action_type = 'checkout_error' AND created_at > now() - interval '15 minutes') * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE action_type IN ('checkout_started', 'checkout_error') AND created_at > now() - interval '15 minutes'), 0) as error_rate

alert_rules.name: Authentication Failure Spike
alert_rules.description: Potential brute-force attack or credential stuffing

actions.details: Automatically ban IP for 24 hours after 20 failed attempts
Log potential brute-force attack

alert_rules.supabase_query: SELECT ip_address, COUNT(*) as attempts FROM audit_logs WHERE action_type = 'failed_login' AND created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY ip_address HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

alert_rules.name: PHI Access Anomaly Detected
alert_rules.description: Unusual pattern of PHI access (e.g., bulk patient record access)

actions.details: Log PHI access anomaly with full user context
Optionally terminate user session pending review
Flag for HIPAA compliance review

alert_rules.supabase_query: SELECT user_id, user_email, COUNT(*) as access_count FROM audit_logs WHERE action_type = 'patient_phi_accessed' AND created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY user_id, user_email HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50

alert_rules.name: Database Slow Query Detected
alert_rules.description: Query execution time exceeds 5 seconds (performance degradation)

actions.details: Log slow query with execution plan
Add to weekly performance optimization backlog

alert_rules.supabase_query: SELECT query, mean_exec_time, calls FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE mean_exec_time > 5000 ORDER BY mean_exec_time DESC LIMIT 10

alert_rules.name: Subscription Payment Failure

actions.details: Log payment failure with practice_id and error code
Send email to practice owner with payment update link
Activate 7-day grace period before service suspension

alert_rules.supabase_query: SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE action_type = 'subscription_payment_failed' AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
